parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.82 indicates substantial structural overlap between `calculatesAvgShaderFPS` (line 319) and `calculatesWorkloadReduction` (line 427), these are distinct test scenarios exercising different observable behaviours of `QualityMetricsAggregator` — average shader FPS versus workload reduction — whose structural resemblance is a natural consequence of the arrange-act-assert pattern common to unit tests. Merging or abstracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated assertions, reducing diagnostic clarity when either test fails.
